The '''Rebel Knights of Solitude''' were a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] resistance group operating on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core World]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].

Ranks or titles within this group included Eye of Solitude, Foot of Solitude, Hand of Solitude, Mind of Solitude and Will of Solitude.
